newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Pro-president party wins most seats in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Pro-president party wins most seats in Algeria.

text.p: The Algerian party seen as a major supporter of President Liamine Zeroual won 155 seats to dominate Algeria's first parliamentary election held after five years of violence.

The National Democratic Rally (RND) was followed well behind by a moderate Islam-oriented party Movement of a peaceful Society (MPS), which won 69 seats, Interior Minister Mustapha Benmansour told a news conference on Friday.
